Author: Alex Vallière
Name: Submarine ETA Planner
Punchline: Plan and monitor your Free Company submarine fleets.
Description: Plan Free Company submarine operations from local SubmarineTracker data: choose which tracked FCs to show, prioritize returns and next actions, forecast leveling and sector unlocks, review recorded salvage income and project future farming earnings, configure farming routes, and estimate ceruleum fuel runway. Requires Submarine Tracker to be installed and enabled. Open it with /seta. The installer icon was created with AI assistance.
Changelog: Version 1.1.0 adds Income → Projection with 30/90/365-day gross salvage estimates from current farming setups. Uses the last 90 days of matching history, requires 10 returns, and pools other visible FCs when needed. Includes partial totals, sample details, and daily/monthly charts. Existing History and saved fleet settings are preserved.
